title: Compliance review — T9 against the live Statement of Architecture Work
body:
# Compliance review — T9 TOGAF ADM capability (Phase G, retrospective, 2026-11-22)

## Relationship

Recorded level: `compliant with named deviations`. T9 implements the architecture capability of SPEC_V2 §8.1 and proves most of the §12 gate by named real-Postgres tests, but six P1/P2 findings remain open and the fifth gate clause is not proved.

## Findings

The open findings, each by ledger id: v1-p81-4 (P1) — a draft Architecture Board can govern and be approved with an empty charter. v1-p81-5 (P1) — untyped, unprojected artefacts and links with no tenant/project consistency. v1-p81-6 (P2) — Phase H enforces existence, not exactly one typed outcome; the plan's `crates/api/tests/togaf_h_change.rs::a_systemic_finding_produces_a_kata_candidate` is absent at HEAD, while `::a_scope_change_produces_a_change_register_row`, `::an_unrecorded_review_refuses_the_gate` and `crates/actions/tests/togaf_kata_outcome.rs` prove the component paths. v1-w2a-3 (P1) — profile adoption accepts any UUID as its board decision. v1-w2a-4 (P1) — `contracts_request` retires another project's live contract through `supersedes_id`. v1-w2a-6 (P2) — `phase_progress` reports a phase evidenced by draft artefacts and superseded contracts. The resolved findings remain resolved: v1-p81-1, v1-p81-2, v1-p81-3, v1-w2a-2, v1-u5a-t9-1 and v1-u5a-t9-2 were closed at `92e6b223` with the tests named in the review evidence. The delivered clauses are proved by `architecture_artifacts.rs`, `architecture_capability.rs`, `togaf_architecture_phases.rs`, `togaf_delivery_design_gate.rs` and `architecture_compliance.rs` as listed in the Phase-G findings.

## Waivers

No waiver is granted. None of the open findings is accepted as a deviation: each is a work package owned by T9, with an acceptance clause, and the level stays compliant-with-deviations rather than waived. A waiver would require an accepting asset owner, the reason, the additional cost and risk, and a reassessment date; the waiver action refuses one without an owner and a date, proved by `architecture_compliance.rs::one_level_and_a_dated_waiver`.

## Decision

Record `compliant with named deviations` for the delivery of T9 against the T9 delivery contract. The project may close on the programme's P0-only product gate because no open P0 finding remains; the six P1/P2 findings are carried as dated packages, not waived. This review is retrospective: no Phase-G review existed at the 2026-11-18 close.
